sources: https://www.sandwichfair.com/camping/ (Sandwich Fair; read live with the headless browser, desktop Chrome UA, 2026-11-20): 'Camping season is May 1-October 31. Closed November 1-April 30. Non-fair time camping at the fairgrounds campground is by appointment only. Please contact Sue at 989-309-0202 to make arrangements for general non-fair time camping. Non-Fair Time Camping Cost: $25 Nightly, $500 Monthly. No tent camping or open fires allowed in the campground. Park in designated spots only.' ON-SITE SERVICES: 'Electrical hookup (20, 30 &, and 50 amps); Water access; Dump site (and dumpsters); 2-Portable Toilets'. 'FAIR TIME CAMPING (NON-LIVESTOCK) AUGUST 25 - SEPTEMBER 15 ... East Side Campground (Non-Livestock) on the northeast side of the grounds. 5 day minimum stay during the fair for $175 and $35 each additional day.' Livestock exhibitors camp on the west side ($175 for up to 5 days; office 815-786-2159).

summary: Fair camping page read live via headless browser. Confirmed May 1-Oct 31 season, $25 nightly / $500 monthly outside the fair by appointment (phone), 20/30/50 A, water access, dump, portable toilets; fair-time 5-day minimum. Ordinary non-fair nights are rented. Not waterfront kept; pin = Google's point.
flags: FAIRGROUNDS (passes the ordinary-nights test): the fair posts a non-fair nightly rate ('Non-Fair Time Camping Cost: $25 Nightly, $500 Monthly') for 'general non-fair time camping', May 1-Oct 31. Booking is 'by appointment only' through one contact (Sue, 989-309-0202) - the reviewer may read 'by appointment only' as close to the discouraging-wording list; it does not say nightly stays are limited or by approval. Google 4.5 over 54.
WATER: the page lists 'Water access' among on-site services, not water at each site; the stored hookups.water true (note-derived) is left alone but unconfirmed.
FAIR TIME: Aug 25 - Sep 15 the East Side Campground sells a 5-day minimum ($175, then $35/day) - recorded in the season and fee notes, not as a standing minimum.
PHONE 989-309-0202 is the fair's posted camping contact (a Michigan-area-code mobile); the fair office is 815-786-2159. WEBSITE confirmed.
